## Conference enquiries

For questions about the Japan QCA Conference 2026, the calls for abstracts and papers, or participation, contact the organizational team at:

::: {.contact-card}
**Email**  
[jqca2026@gmail.com](mailto:jqca2026@gmail.com)
:::

Please do not send an abstract by email unless the organizers specifically request it. The approved online submission form will be added to the [Call for Papers](registration.qmd) page when available.

The website does not collect names, email addresses, or other personal data.
